newly_created_decisions.subject: Admit Tru by Hilton Indianapolis Lawrence to the census?
newly_created_decisions.question: This is a real hotel inside the market that the pinned census does not contain. Admit it?
evidence: Hilton's own locality inventory lists property code inddlru
the property's own Hilton page states 5660 Lawrence Village Parkway, Indianapolis, IN 46216, telephone +1 317-541-8803
the BringFido lead agrees on postal, street number and telephone independently
Atlas holds no census row at that premises
it is NOT the existing 'tru by hilton indianapolis downtown', which is 601 Russell Avenue 46202 under code inddwru; Hilton lists both codes separately
its first-party pet policy is already captured and is publication-grade: pets allowed, dog or cat, 2 max, 50 lbs, $50 for 1-4 nights and $75 for 5+ nights, non-refundable
newly_created_decisions.recommendation: ADMIT. Identity is deterministic on street, postal, telephone and brand property code, and corroborated by two independent sources. The policy is first-party and complete.
newly_created_decisions.authority_effect: one additional PUBLISHED_PET_FRIENDLY, taking the projection to 82
newly_created_decisions.reversibility: a census admission is reversible by retirement with lineage
newly_created_decisions.blocks_promotion: NO -- it sits outside the 21-row clean inventory and can be admitted in the same order or a later one

newly_created_decisions.subject: Hotel Nickel Plate Fishers -- an identity BOTH directories missed
newly_created_decisions.question: Investigate and admit?
evidence: Hilton's official Fishers-area inventory lists property code indelup
BringFido did not list it either, so it is not a competitor lead -- the brand's own inventory found it
newly_created_decisions.recommendation: Investigate on the free lane before ruling. No policy evidence was captured in this order and none should be assumed.
newly_created_decisions.authority_effect: unknown until its policy is read
newly_created_decisions.worth_noting: a competitor census challenge found 15 candidates; the BRAND's own inventory found one that the competitor did not. The brand surface is the better discovery source of the two.

newly_created_decisions.subject: 24 same-brand, same-city BringFido rows that did not bind to Atlas premises
newly_created_decisions.question: Confirm these are worked as address adjudications rather than treated as new hotels.
evidence: each has an Atlas row of the same brand family in the same city but a different street or postal
that is exactly the shape of an address conflict or a duplicate listing, and it is also the shape a genuine second property of the same brand takes

name similarity was explicitly NOT allowed to decide: the diagnostic paired 'Motel 6 Southport' with 'motel 6 indianapolis airport' and 'Spark Fishers' with 'hilton garden inn northeast fishers', and both pairings are wrong
newly_created_decisions.recommendation: Work them on the free lane, one at a time, binding each on the property page's own street, postal and telephone. Do not bulk-correct any address, and do not admit any as a new identity without that read.
newly_created_decisions.census_effect: unknown until worked -- some will be address supersessions on existing rows, some may be genuine second properties
newly_created_decisions.blocks_promotion: NO -- none of them is in the clean inventory
newly_created_decisions.note: this is the largest single block of unfinished identity work the challenge produced, and it is free to work

explicitly_not_reopened: F-004-3, the settled ruling that Zionsville is outside this market by contract. Four BringFido rows sit in the Zionsville corridor and were classified OUTSIDE_ATLAS_MARKET on the strength of that existing ruling, not re-argued.
